limitations: Twenty-one unique exposed misses, 24 frozen synthetic constructions and four repeats; truth and descriptions are audit-only, not representative external SAT evidence.

Units wraps the preceding shared unit-cofactor policy. Conflict adds checked paths refuting a binary subset. Relations additionally substitutes one largest checked signed binary SCC block per incoming cofactor, cleans duplicate literals and tautologies without renaming, and propagates units again.

All structural modes use root folding, depth two, bag width eight, 262144 reserved bucket probes per node and identical local unit limits. One equivalence block per incoming edge is a bounded candidate, not complete binary closure. Binary conflict discovery and equivalence discovery currently run separate graph traversals.

Every incoming edge retains initial units, optional binary relation evidence and post-substitution units. Replay reconstructs both normalization maps and lifts signed representative values before incoming units. Contradiction paths are checked against the exact binary-clause subsequence; no SCC labels are trusted.

Full normalized quotient plus remaining depth under fixed policy is the local memo identity; exact root programs also share within the stream. Edits invalidate incoming evidence. Policy/depth changes invalidate reuse. Unknown is not UNSAT.

The depth-two binary partition retains both children and partial bucket programs. At depth d there are at most 2^(d+1)-1 incoming requests. Recognition/closure/lookup on memo hits and incoming transport remain charged; no unrestricted small-state guarantee.

All workflows start empty with one common fallback. Complete time includes preparation, discovery, checking, JSON/SQLite writes, warm reuse, cold reconstruction and compression. Interpreter startup, report metadata, generation, post-hoc profiles, history and preservation audit are additional.

Both native cold readers audit fallback; two additional JSON passes use the same relation/bucket checker, not independent JSON implementations. Native, equivalence, affine and Lean formats are unchanged. Units is the old policy in a new wrapper, not historical timing replay.

The first draft skipped normalization between substitution and unit indexing; a signed three-variable counterexample, failed tests and draft pilot are retained. Cleanup was fixed before protocol freeze and matched measurements. No production defaults or unrestricted-SAT claims change.
